Re-ran the original repro today on opencode 1.14.30 (same version as in the OP) on macOS 26.3 — and the multi-segment globstar patterns I had reported as failing **now match correctly**. Only the leading-slash absolute patterns still fail, which lines up exactly with #20045's diagnosis (`edit` receives paths relative to `Instance.worktree`, so a pattern starting with `/` can't match the un-slashed input).

Fresh table, target = `/tmp/agent-out/x.txt`, same `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` shape as the OP, only the pattern varies:

| Pattern | Result |
|---|---|
| `**/agent-out/**` | ✅ matches |
| `**/tmp/agent-out/**` | ✅ matches *(was reported failing in OP — now works)* |
| `**/private/tmp/agent-out/**` | ✅ matches *(was reported failing in OP — now works)* |
| `/tmp/agent-out/**` | ❌ blocked |
| `/private/tmp/agent-out/**` | ❌ blocked |

So my original report of a distinct multi-segment-globstar bug doesn't reproduce anymore. The remaining failures are the same root cause as #20045 (and the broader unification ask in #22465).

For context, #23276 takes the narrower route suggested by this discussion: it leaves the shared `sync.data.session` bootstrap unchanged, so child session prev/next and root-to-child navigation can still rely on the mixed session index.

The root-only query is scoped to `DialogSessionList`'s own resource for the default picker/search results, and it preserves the current scope/path filter from `sync.session.query()`. That should avoid the shared-store issue called out above while still preventing child sessions from crowding root sessions out of the picker.
